item.title: Choose how Murph shows up
item.summary: Choose Murph's main and optional supporting personality in Settings, or ask Murph to change them in chat.
item.details: Both paths update the same saved personality. Explicit tone, voice, Humor, Push, and Detail choices stay unchanged; where you have not customized tone or voice, Settings shows the selected personality's defaults. A group request changes only that room's Murph rather than anyone's private settings.
